summary: IonQ filed an 8-K disclosing an October 14, 2026 underwriting agreement with J.P. Morgan as sole underwriter for a marketed offering of 20.5 million common shares, 29.5 million pre-funded warrants, and 100 million Series C warrants, each share or pre-funded warrant paired with two Series C warrants at a combined $40.00 public price. Series C warrants strike at $69.46, exercisable immediately through the seven-year anniversary; pre-funded warrants carry a $0.0001 strike. This is a routine equity/warrant shelf-style takedown, not a special situation; watch warrant overhang and dilution.
